title: Sales Report Pydantic v2 schemas
scope: Three Pydantic v2 BaseModels: ConsolidationRow (6 fields), TransactionRow (10 fields incl. `place` per DS-013), SalesReportResponse (consolidation + transactions). All carry ConfigDict(from_attributes=True). Pure data classes — no validators, no business logic, no imports of project modules beyond pydantic.

success_criteria.automated: T-062 + T-065 integration tests (TC-133, TC-140) serialize/deserialize without raising.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: File exports exactly 3 BaseModels with the fields enumerated in the LLD. No other exports.

checkout_prompt: ConsolidationRow, TransactionRow, SalesReportResponse created. Ready for SalesReportService projection in T-062.
